newsitem.title: USA: Capital Corp sees Q2 loss of $0.36 per shr.
newsitem.headline: Capital Corp sees Q2 loss of $0.36 per shr.

text.p: Capital Corp of the West said Wednesday it expects to report a consolidated loss of about $430,000 or $0.16 per share for the six-month period ended June 30, and a consolidated loss of about $940,000 or $0.36 per share for the three-month period ended June 30, after giving effect to nonrecurring events.
In the second quarter, the company said it recognised a gain of about $515,000 on asset sales from its real estate subsidiary that in part offset the loan loss provision.
